items.name: Finsupp.ofSupportFinite_support
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] {f : α → M} (hf : (Function.support f).Finite) : (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite f hf).support = hf.toFinset

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.smul_eq
items.type: {G : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [VAdd G P] [IsLeftCancelVAdd G P] [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [SMulWithZero R V] (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) (x : P → V) (p : P) (hp : ((↑f.coeff.support).vaddAntidiagonal (Function.support x) p).Finite := ⋯) : (f • x) p = ∑ gh ∈ Finset.VAddAntidiagonal p hp, f.coeff gh.1 • x gh.2
